## Giveaway checklist (public repo)

- [ ] No real client, contact or company names; fixtures stay fictional (dana-studio, noa-bakery)
- [ ] No prices, currency amounts, invoices or meeting content from real work
- [ ] No internal tool names, issue numbers or private repo paths
- [ ] `bash scripts/validate-kit.sh` is green locally (paste the last line)
- [ ] If a SKILL.md changed: SKILL_HE.md updated and its `mirrors` stamp still matches
- [ ] If behavior changed: a `behavioral-spec.json` case covers it
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has an entry under Unreleased
